text:
incident-bot: ALERT: inference-prod p99 latency climbed to 8.2s and 5xx rate ~6.8% over the last 4m. deploy=2026-03-17T06:12Z tagged. paging oncall @jordan-oncall :rotating_light:

alice: seeing same in our dashboards, traces show request hangs around kv-cache lookup phase. many timeouts to model-backend-2

jordan-oncall: on it. paging SRE. assigning priority P0. taking pager. starting tracing collection — @priya can you run quick top-level metrics?

priya: running queries now. p95=1.3s pre-deploy, p95=2.7s now. p99 jumped from 2.9s to 8.2s. 5xxs mostly 504/gateway timeouts. spike aligns with deploy at 06:12.

mike-englead: flagged in rollout notes: small kernel change + kvcache eviction tweak. suspect cache eviction pressure. any evidence of kv thrashing?

alice: logs show kvcache eviction storms on host-gpu-12: frequent eviction events then reconnects to kvstore. sample log:
```
[06:13:18] kvcache: evict:keyspace=enc-cache size=124MB reason=pressure
[06:13:18] kvcache: open_conn host=kv-3 err="timeout"
[06:13:19] inference: request wait_for_cache=true 
```

priya: correlating: error budget heatmap shows requests with large context length hitting new kernel path. that path calls into kvcache twice more.

jordan-oncall: urgent mitigation options: 1) revert deploy 2) toggle kvcache conservative mode 3) throttle requests by routing to older variant. prefer fastest safe action.

alice: we can flip kvcache -> conservative immediately via feature flag. patch ready: `patch kvcache.mode=conservative --env inference-prod`

sam-product: customers already report slow completions on status page monitor. need ETA on mitigation and whether to send customer note.

priya: conservative flip applied to 20% of traffic now. metrics updating... p99 at 20% slice down to 3.1s. overall still high.

jordan-oncall: good signal. can we ramp to 100%? if risk low, do it and monitor for regressions.

alice: ramping to 60% -> 100% now.

deploy-bot: FLAG: feature-flag toggle applied by alice at 06:19:42Z. rollout to 100% started.

priya: after full flip p99 down to 2.4s, 5xx to ~1.2% in last 2m. improvement looks steady.

mike-englead: still think revert is safer long-term until we patch kvcache path. but flip bought time. recommend rollback to previous deploy and open rollout fix PR.

jordan-oncall: concur. initiating rollback to 2026-03-17T06:08 stable tag. @deploy-bot please start rollback.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK: rollback to tag=stable-2026-03-17T06:08 initiated by jordan-oncall at 06:22:11Z. cluster orchestration starting. estimated time ~2m.

alice: curl probe against inference-prod endpoint after rollback completion shows 200 in 120ms for 10/10 requests. `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://inference.prod/api/v1/complete`

priya: metrics post-rollback: p95=1.1s, p99=1.9s, 5xx ~0.4%. seems stable.

sam-product: recommend sending short status update to customers: issue caused by kvcache eviction behavior after deploy; mitigated via rollback; investigating root cause and ETA for fix. any objections?

mike-englead: +1. start postmortem and include timeline, deploy diff, and kvcache telemetry.

jordan-oncall: closing pager soon. handoff: follow-up owners: alice (patch & feature flag cleanup), priya (telemetry), mike-englead (postmortem lead), sam-product (customer comms).

incident-bot: INCIDENT: resolved. severity=P1 -> monitoring. postmortem ticket CREATED: PM-1234.

jordan-oncall: thanks all. I'll do a brief sync with support to coordinate customer note. handing off to oncall review channel for root cause write-up. :white_check_mark:
